title: 12-apps: SOS multicast endpoint, /sos/log, and emergency network behavior (18.4)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.4 gaps: (1) POST coap://[ff02::1]/sos multicast endpoint not implemented — only unicast /sos (coap_server.c:574, emergency.py:202). (2) /sos/log emergency log resource not implemented (listed P2 in spec-chapter-breakdowns.md:1627). (3) Beacon boost every 30s during SOS: only SosResource.retrigger() primitive exists (emergency.py:192-195), no 30s scheduler. (4) SOS 4-hour auto-timeout: 4h only appears as relay dedup expiry (sos_relay.py:41-43); active SOS never auto-deactivates. Also 18.4.4 SOS hardware button behavior has no implementation. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-036/037/038/041/042.
